description: 25V 4.7uF X7R ±10% 1206 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 1206 4.7 uF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C29823 (FH 1206B475K500NT, 50 V X7R +/-10%). C1872 is the exact Samsung 25 V rated SKU (CL31B475KAHNNNE, X7R +/-10%), so it gets its own rated-variant ID (25_volt suffix) linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established rated-variant taxonomy (as with the C1592 16 V row). Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 4.7 uF value, package and X7R +/-10%, but 25 V is a lower rating than the 50 V preference - the variant must never silently replace the 50 V part in higher-voltage circuits; it exists so 25 V-class designs can pick the exact SKU explicitly. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 33,006 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
